top_signals.title: Euro Falls as Russia Risk, France Protests Dent Trader Sentiment
top_signals.summary: The euro fell against most of its Group-of-10 peers as escalating tensions in Ukraine and widespread protests in France dented sentiment toward the common currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Bounce After Chip Rout, Oil Slips: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity-index futures rebounded from last week’s chip rout as investors turned to earnings for direction amid mounting pressure on the artificial intelligence trade. Oil slipped.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
